description: This PHP class 'Skill' extends ListableDisplayField and defines display logic for a 'Skill' entity within HR reporting. It specifies the DTO class, entity aliases, and fields involved in the report context.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Represents a display field for skills in HR report generation, providing methods to specify DTO class, entity alias, and report-specific fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field, which is 'Dto\Skill'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides an array of entity aliases used in database query contexts, here returning ['skill'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields related to employee skills, specifically ['employee.empNumber'].
